assignments.node_id: ההתבודדות צריך מקום וזמן מיחד, שלא יבלבלו אותו המונעים. והזמן הוא בלילה, הינו הנעור בלילה, שאז הכל ישנים. והמקום הוא בדרך יחידי, ולא בדרך הרבים, שלא יפסיקנו עוברי דרכים
assignments.reason: This node IS hitbodedut described with its defining conditions — the special time (night, when all are asleep) and the special place (solitary path, not a public road). Its essential nature is the practice of hitbodedut itself, not a cause or effect of it. The node text is a definitional expansion of what hitbodedut requires, matching Package 3's domain of the practice, its temporal dimension (night), and its spatial dimension (solitary path).

assignments.node_id: צריך שילך לבדו בלילה, בדרך יחידי, במקום שאין שם אדם. ושם ילך ויתבודד, ויפנה לבו ודעתו מכל עסקי עולם הזה, ויבטל הכל
assignments.reason: This node describes the complete practice of hitbodedut: walking alone at night, on a solitary path where no one is present, doing hitbodedut, clearing one's heart and mind of worldly affairs. Its essential nature is the hitbodedut practice with all its conditions. Although the tail phrase 'ויבטל הכל' mentions bitul, the node as a whole describes the practice-setting, not the state of bitul itself. It belongs in Package 3 as an extended description of hitbodedut's practical form.

assignments.node_id: מתבודד ומפרש שיחתו בינו לבין קונו
assignments.reason: This node describes the core act of hitbodedut — secluding oneself and expressing one's personal speech before God. Its essential nature is the practice of hitbodedut in its experiential dimension (שיחה בינו לבין קונו is already in Package 3). This is not a cause leading to something else; it IS the hitbodedut practice. It produces bitul (as the eitza edge shows), but its own nature is prayer-in-seclusion.

Doing God's will is the telos of nishmat Yisrael — the very purpose for which souls were emanated and the world created. Line 7 of the Torah: 'עִקַּר הַכַּוָּנָה שֶׁבָּרָא כָּל הָעוֹלָם בִּשְׁבִיל יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל יַעֲשׂוּ רְצוֹנוֹ.' Its essential nature is the divine purpose — the fulfillment of the mechuyav/achdut framework. It is not a practice (like hitbodedut) or a state (like bitul), but the teleological core of the Divine-Israel relationship that Package 1 captures.

assignments.node_id: חוזרין ונכללין בו יתברך שהוא מחיב המציאות, ואז נכללין עמהם כל העולמות התלויים בנפשם, בחיוב המציאות כנ"ל
assignments.reason: This node describes the culminating state: being subsumed back into God who is mechuyav ha-metziut, with all worlds dependent on Israel's souls also becoming included in mechuyav status. Its essential nature IS mechuyav ha-metziut — it is the destination-state of divine unity. The node text explicitly names מחיב המציאות twice and describes the ontological subsumption that is Package 1's central theme.

assignments.node_id: שישראל עושין רצונו של מקום, ונכללין בשרשם
assignments.reason: Israel doing God's will and being subsumed in their root — this compound concept describes both the teleological act (doing God's will) and its ontological consequence (inclusion in the shoresh). Both elements belong to Package 1: nishmat Yisrael is already there, 'שרשו' is already there, and the doing of God's will is the mechanism by which souls return to their divine root. The essential nature is the Israel-God unity relationship.

assignments.node_id: נכלל כל העולם שנברא בשבילם, בחיוב המציאות
assignments.reason: The entire world becoming subsumed in mechuyav ha-metziut — this IS the cosmic-scale expression of Package 1's central concept. When Israel returns to the Divine root, all worlds that depend on Israel's souls also achieve mechuyav status. Its essential nature is mechuyav ha-metziut applied universally, not a separate domain.

assignments.node_id: לזכות לזה להכלל בשרשו, דהינו לחזר ולהכלל באחדות השם יתברך, שהוא מחיב המציאות
assignments.reason: Being subsumed in one's root, which is explicitly glossed as 'אחדות השם יתברך, שהוא מחיב המציאות.' This node uses the exact definitional chain of Package 1: shoresh = divine unity = mechuyav ha-metziut. Its essential nature is the Divine unity destination — all three terms already reside in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: נכלל נפשו בשרשו, דהינו בו יתברך, שהוא מחיב המציאות. אזי נכלל כל העולם עם נפשו בשרשו, שהוא מחיב המציאות, כי הכל תלוי בו כנ"ל, ואזי נעשה כל העולם על ידו בבחינת מחיב המציאות כנ"ל
assignments.reason: The fullest expression of the mechuyav ha-metziut culmination: one's soul is subsumed in its root (= God = mechuyav), and through this all worlds also become mechuyav. The node mentions מחיב המציאות three times and שרשו twice. Its essential nature is entirely within the ontological domain of Package 1 — divine unity and necessary existence.

Achieving bitul. This node IS the state of bitul expressed as a goal ('to come to bitul'). Its essential nature is bitul — the self-nullification that Package 2 captures. It appears as the effect of hitbodedut (edge 1555), but the concept itself belongs to the bitul domain, not the hitbodedut domain.

assignments.node_id: לבטל כל התאוות והמדות רעות, עד שזוכה לבטל כל גשמיותו, ולהכלל בשרשו
assignments.reason: Nullifying all desires and evil traits, then all physicality, until being subsumed in one's root. This is the progressive process of bitul — from nullifying specific traits to nullifying all materiality. Its essential nature is bitul as a process. Although the endpoint ('ולהכלל בשרשו') touches Package 1, the node as a whole describes the bitul-journey, and the dominant concept is the act of nullification (לבטל appears twice). The desires and traits are what is being nullified, not the node's essential identity.

assignments.node_id: בטול. שיבטל עצמו לגמרי, עד שיהיה נכלל באחדותו יתברך
assignments.reason: Complete self-nullification until subsumed in divine unity. The node begins with the word 'בטול' as its label and then defines what bitul means: nullifying oneself completely. Its essential nature IS bitul — Package 2's dominant concept. The endpoint ('נכלל באחדותו יתברך') bridges to Package 1, but the node's identity is bitul, not divine unity.

True bitul. This is bitul qualified by 'באמת' (in truth/truly) — the complete, genuine state of self-nullification that Torah #52 describes as the prerequisite for being subsumed in mechuyav ha-metziut. Its essential nature is unmistakably bitul — Package 2's core domain.
